_why: The machines that are supposed to be running our CI. The runner watchdog counted online runners PER REPOSITORY and was satisfied by one, so when all 24 of the office PC's runners were deregistered on 2026-08-25 the laptop kept every repository's count above zero and nothing alarmed for a week. This file is what makes a whole machine's absence visible.
_naming: Runners are registered as wsl-<MACHINE>-<repo>[-N]. The MACHINE here is the Windows machine name, exactly as it appears in that registration.
_adding_a_machine: Add its name here in the same commit that registers its runners, otherwise the watchdog reports it as UNKNOWN MACHINE.
_do_not_add_the_work_pc: DESKTOP-124K6MV is Roger's work PC and must NOT host CI runners. It was retired deliberately on 2026-08-25. On 2026-09-01 commit 446cfee read that retirement as a fault ('half our build capacity disappeared') and 24 runners were re-registered there without asking him. Roger, 2026-09-03: 'I never said that. Everything should be running on the laptop. The work PC is for work only and not for anything else.' The runners were removed again the same day. An absent DESKTOP-124K6MV is the intended state, not an incident: do not add it back to this list, and do not treat its absence as lost capacity. If the laptop is down, the watchdog's RUNNER_LABEL flip moves the fleet to GitHub-hosted runners - that is the fallback, not the work PC.
